items.title: Best Buy taps AI platform for supplier insights
items.zh_title: 百思买引入 AI 平台洞察供应商表现
items.zh_oneliner: 百思买用 AI 平台分析供应商数据，优化采购与补货决策。
items.en_oneliner: Best Buy is using an AI platform to analyze supplier data and sharpen purchasing and replenishment decisions.

items.title: Delivery Promise Gap? Investigate Before Raising Ad Spend
items.zh_title: 配送承诺有落差？先查清再加广告预算
items.zh_oneliner: 广告花钱前先核对实际配送时效，承诺与履约的落差会直接拖累转化。
items.en_oneliner: Check actual delivery times before raising ad spend — a gap between promise and fulfillment drags down conversion.
